design_issues.screen: RollJourneyPopup overlay vs floating help button
issues: `roll-journey-popup` testid does NOT end in `-dialog`/`-modal` so the CSS rule in /app/frontend/src/styles/layout.css:354 (body:has(.modal-overlay, [role="dialog"][data-state="open"], [data-testid$="-modal"], [data-testid$="-dialog"]) .tour-fab { display:none }) does NOT hide the FAB when the journey popup is open. In the current screenshot the FAB does not visually overlap the centered popup, but the fix is incomplete for this component. Suggest renaming testid to `roll-journey-dialog` or `-modal`, or adding an explicit selector.

action_items: Make FAB-hide rule also cover roll-journey-popup (rename testid to end with -dialog/-modal, or extend CSS selector in layout.css line 354).

RollHoldControl: the submit button uses the same data-testid `roll-hold-submit` for both HOLD and RELEASE flows. The problem brief references `roll-release-submit` as separate testid — consider using dynamic `roll-${mode}-submit` to disambiguate.
